allow_instructions: Allow routine git read commands (status, diff, log, show, branch, remote, rev-parse, ls-remote) without asking.
Allow git add/commit/push for project version releases when the user asked for versão/nova versão do projeto, as long as .env and secrets are not staged.
Allow Shell calls that use required_permissions all/git_write/full_network only for those safe git operations in this repo.
block_instructions: Always require approval for git push --force, git push --force-with-lease, git reset --hard, git clean -fd, and any git config changes.
Always require approval for commands that read, print, copy, or commit .env, API keys, tokens, or credential files.
Block committing or pushing secrets even if the user message mentions a new version.
